existing_tests.outcome: The corrected baseline recorded exactly 13 cases: eight ownership failures and five preservation passes. The guard-retry test exercises tracer, timing, completion, and origin guards, retries after context B, and proves the captured A entry was consumed before the retry uses legacy B.
existing_tests.native_limit: The accepted native design proves real automatic URLProtocol start/release/completion receipts, serialized client spans, request-time owners, explicit nil before RUM, and reverse completion. It does not prove registered-mode RUM ownership.

limit.source_result: The new dictionary retains only a value-type RUMCoreContext keyed by an existing interception UUID and removes it before every completion guard. No new task, host, interception, scope, or callback is retained by the change.
limit.unbind_contract: No DatadogURLSessionHandler unregister API exists in the inspected protocol; NetworkInstrumentationFeature stores handlers and finish notifies each handler before removing the interception. E05 explicitly disclaims immediate-unbind, hard-capacity, and measured-footprint claims.
limit.decision: Do not invent an immediate-unbind test or claim a bounded map high-water guarantee. Treat release of the handler itself as existing feature lifecycle behavior, outside this E05 patch; retain the completed-interception cleanup proof above.
